interface.longDescription:
Search Sander Saar's library of more than 120 tech videos and play the exact moment that answers your question. The library covers AI tools and assistants, AI agents, mixed reality headsets, smart glasses, fitness and sleep trackers, WiFi routers, cameras, self-driving cars and robotaxis, tech in China, and the business of media and platforms, from 2014 to today.

Ask in plain words. The plugin finds the matching moment, plays it from the right second, and names the video and the timecode. It can also answer a direct question from what Sander says or shows on screen.

The plugin only reads Sander Saar's public video library. It needs no account. It does not post, buy, upload, or change anything. If the library has no good match, it says so instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: Which fitness tracker did Sander Saar pick after 30 days with Whoop, Oura, Apple Watch and Eight Sleep?
What does Sander Saar think of the Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses?
Play Sander Saar's first Waymo robotaxi ride.

positive.description: Finds and plays the verdict from a 30-day fitness tracker test.
positive.prompt: Which fitness tracker does Sander Saar recommend after testing Whoop, Oura, Apple Watch and Eight Sleep for 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the video "30 days. Real life test. Best fitness trackers: Whoop vs Oura vs Apple Watch vs Eight Sleep" and plays the moment with Sander's verdict (often near the end of the video). Sander says the Apple Watch is the best all-around choice for most people and Whoop suits athletes. The reply names the video and the timecode of the moment it plays.

positive.description: Finds the verdict on a new pair of smart glasses.
positive.prompt: What does Sander Saar think of the Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds "Tried Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses. The screen is useful. The Neural Band is game-changing." and plays a moment from it. Sander says the display is useful for silent AI use, navigation, texts and calls, but the Neural Band wristband is the real breakthrough: it reads the signals in his wrist muscles, so he can swipe and tap with his hand in his pocket. The reply names the video and the timecode of the moment it plays.

positive.description: Answers a direct question with numbers from a router test.
positive.prompt: In Sander Saar's Eero test, how much faster is WiFi 7 than WiFi 6?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that WiFi 7 was more than twice as fast as WiFi 6 in Sander's tests, with the speeds he measured (for example 204 Mbps for the Eero Pro 6 against 454 Mbps for the Eero Max 7 next to the router). Cites "WiFi 7 vs WiFi 6 - Real Life Tests with Eero 7 Max vs Eero 6 Pro" with a timecode.

positive.description: Plays a named moment on request.
positive.prompt: Play Sander Saar's first Waymo robotaxi ride.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds "#Robotaxis are here - join my first autonomous ride with #Waymo!" and plays it from the start, where Sander orders the car and notes its 29 cameras, four lidars and three radars. The reply names the video.

positive.description: Finds a commentary moment on a topic.
positive.prompt: What does Sander Saar say about ChatGPT apps becoming the new app store?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds "ChatGPT Apps. The New App Store?" and plays a moment from it. Sander explains that the apps run on MCP, an open standard, that payments are built in, and compares 800 million weekly users and early adopters with the first App Store. The reply names the video and the timecode of the moment it plays.

negative.description: Booking a ride is out of scope. The plugin only searches and plays videos.
negative.prompt: Book me a Waymo ride in San Francisco for tonight.

negative.description: Uploading or changing videos is out of scope. The plugin only reads the public library.
negative.prompt: Upload my vacation video and add it to my library.

negative.description: Shopping is out of scope. The plugin does not compare prices or buy products.
negative.prompt: Find the cheapest Oura Ring and order it for me.
